requirement_vague: Update a items title and description as the owner. Confirm the update succeeds and the item retains the same id and owner.
requirement_precise: Authenticate as a superuser with username 'admin@example.com' and password 'password123', create a new item, then update the item's title and description using the superuser credentials. Verify that the update operation returns HTTP status code 200, and the response body contains the updated title and description fields matching the input, as well as the item's id and owner_id fields matching the original item.

implementation.reasoning: The code supports authenticating the seeded superuser admin@example.com/password123 via the login endpoint, creating an item owned by the authenticated user, and updating that item's title and description through PATCH /api/v1/items/{item_id}. The update route returns the updated ItemPublic model with HTTP 200 by default, and because it only changes title/description, the item's id and owner_id remain unchanged and are included in the response.
